summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Flink DataStream initialization from in-memory collections. It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills (URL fetch, ThreadPoolExecutor configuration) which belong to different domains (HTTP I/O, Python concurrency). Peer candidates (text file source, iterator sink, environment setup) are complementary Flink data pipeline skills at the same granularity but represent different stages and methods. No existing skill covers in-memory collection-based DataStream initialization. Support evidence confirms the capability is documented in DataStream API.
